encoding_proposal.format: u64BE length-prefix domain; u64BE sorted member count and each UTF8 member; u64BE sorted relationship count and From/Kind/To UTF8 length-prefix triples
encoding_proposal.ordering: UTF8 byte lexicographic IDs; tuples by From,Kind,To; no order digest, seed or role allocation

non_group_provenance_policy.statement: Existing observer/stdlib infrastructure stays pinned global provenance. It is not silently omitted from provenance and does not acquire new grouping edges. 60/61 review overlays are separately pinned; their findings do not replace saved truth.

relation_recipe.canonical_json_reference_digest: SHA256 Go json.Marshal of exactly pointer-resolved decoded subtree with json.Number; full original artifact SHA is authoritative for missing/null/array state and original bytes.
relation_recipe.meaning: A namespaced encoding of explicit stored parent/candidate/source/prototype/core/component fields plus all original parent-edge reasons; not graph rediscovery or new transitive union.
relation_recipe.metadata_pin_requirement: Future execution must freeze this proposal artifact, all input pins and encoding recipe as well as member-list digest. IDs/edges alone cannot prove full source metadata completeness.

unknowns_and_gaps: No original source/API or AST/object/closure discovery; source-inventory60 and historical saved graphs remain trusted frozen prerequisites.
Snapshot completeness is checked exhaustively against the stored group/source/parent records, not against an unknowable omitted external member.
Source/text fidelity or request coverage uncertainty in 60/61 is not cleared; no loss mask or label correction is applied.
Membership encoding is a proposal. No seed/coverage plan/assignment role is fixed here.
